people.name: Antioch
people.line: A major city where the gospel spread to Gentiles.

translations.web: So, when they were sent off, they came to Antioch. Having gathered the multitude together, they delivered the letter.
translations.bsb: So the men were sent off and went down to Antioch, where they assembled the congregation and delivered the letter.
translations.kjv: So when they were dismissed, they came to Antioch: and when they had gathered the multitude together, they delivered the epistle:
translations.asv: So they, when they were dismissed, came down to Antioch; and having gathered the multitude together, they delivered the epistle.
